day: I was just seeing to things.
evening: Evening. It's been a long day.
Come to the fire when you can.
night: It's late. Shouldn't we be resting?
Quietly, now. The night is for sleeping.

home: I'll keep the house, and cook what you bring in.
outside: I'll go out and see what the woods will give.
I'll gather what I can, and be back by dark.

cook: Bring it here and I'll cook it.
butcher: I'll butcher what you've brought home.
forage: There should be berries and nuts about.
firewood: We'll want wood before the cold.
woodpile: I'll stack the woodpile from what we have.
The pile's running low. I'll see to it.
smoke: I'll hang venison in the smokehouse and keep the smudge going.
Bring me the venison. I'll smoke it.
jerky: I'll cut strips and dry them over the fire.
Jerky keeps through winter. I'll make it.
tan: I'll work the hides at the frame.
Bring the hides and brains, and I'll dress them.
stretch: I'll stretch the pelts on the hoop.
Furs want stretching before they spoil.
teach: I'll sit down with the little one and show it how.

nothing: There's nothing to do just now.

0: We're still finding our feet with one another.
There's time yet. We hardly know each other's ways.
1: We get on well enough, don't we?
2: I look for you when you're away.
It's good to have someone to share the work with.
3: I don't know how I managed before you.
You're the best part of my day.
4: There's no one I trust more.
Whatever comes, we face it together.

spouse: It's a fine calm hour. Shall we do our stretching together, the way I showed you?
Everything's quiet. Would you join me for our yoga?
player: It's a fine calm hour. Will you take the lead in your yoga, and I'll join you?
All is quiet. Shall we do our yoga together? I'll follow your lead.
Which will you take? I'll join you.
You choose, and I'll follow your lead.

accepted_spouse: I'd like that. Come, choose where we'll begin.
accepted_player: Gladly. I'll come to you, and you may choose.
not_full: Not yet. Let's spend more time together first.
Ask me again when we know each other better.
cooldown: We've only just done so. Give it a day.
Not so soon. We should rest a while.
night: Not at night. The day is done.
It's too dark for it. Tomorrow.
danger: Not with danger about. Let's be sure of our safety first.
combat: After that fight? Let your heart settle first.
You're hurt and shaken. Not now.
far: I can't hear you from here. Come closer.
You're too far off. Come to me.
busy: I'm in the middle of my work.

night: It's getting dark. We'd best leave it for the day.
danger: Wait. There's something dangerous near. We'd best stay careful.
Not now. I don't like the look of things.
far: I lost you on the way. Another time, then.
You've gone too far. I'll get back to my work.
blocked: There's no good level ground here. Somewhere flatter.
Not on this ground. Somewhere else.
cancelled: Another time, then. I'll get back to it.
As you like. Back to work.

after: That was good. I feel lighter for it.
Thank you. We should do that again some day.
There. I'm the better for it, and so are you, I hope.

notice: I think we are to have a child. I've missed my courses, and I feel it.
I have news, and I hope it pleases you: I am with child.

middle: The child has quickened. I felt it move this morning.
I'm hungrier than I was, and it shows. The child is thriving.
late: I tire sooner now. I'll leave the heavy work to you.
The child is heavy in me. I'll keep to the lighter chores.
near_term: It won't be long now. Stay close, if you can.
Any day now. I'll not go far from the house.

birth_girl: It's a girl. We have a daughter, and I mean to call her {name}.
A daughter. Look at her. {name}, I think.
birth_boy: It's a boy. We have a son, and I mean to call him {name}.
A son. Look at him. {name}, I think.

early: I've been feeling a little strange, but well enough.
middle: The child is stirring. I'm eating for two, as they say.
late: I can't manage the heavy lifting now. Don't ask it of me.
near_term: Not long now. I'd sooner be near the fire and the bed.
rest: I'm resting a few days after the birth. Let me have the small chores only.

notice: You think you may be with child.
You have missed your time, and you feel changed. You are with child.

middle: You are hungrier these days. The child is growing.
late: You tire sooner now, and the child is heavy.
Heavy work is best left to others now.

birth_girl: You have given birth to a daughter, {name}.
A daughter is born to you: {name}.
birth_boy: You have given birth to a son, {name}.
A son is born to you: {name}.
